power_rules.unlimited: May be used whenever its activation and target requirements are met.
power_rules.limited: Uses equal the hero’s current Game Level unless a power or item says otherwise.
power_rules.concentration: A hero can concentrate on only one effect at a time; damage may require a Constitution save to maintain it.
power_rules.power_attack: 1d20 + the hero’s power ability modifier + proficiency bonus.
power_rules.power_save_dc: 8 + the hero’s power ability modifier + proficiency bonus.
power_rules.exceptions: A named power overrides the general rule when the two conflict.

records.name: Acid Strike
records.resolution: Ranged power attack; adjacent creature makes Dexterity save
records.effect: A corrosive bolt hits one target and splashes another creature adjacent to it.
records.limited_use_rule: If assigned as limited, uses equal the hero’s current Game Level unless the power states another cost.

records.name: Ball-Lightning
records.resolution: Dexterity save; half damage on success
records.effect: Creates a mobile electrical sphere. It can move 30 feet as a Bonus Action and shocks creatures entering or ending in its area.
records.limited_use_rule: If assigned as limited, uses equal the hero’s current Game Level unless the power states another cost.

records.name: Blight
records.resolution: Constitution save; half damage on success
records.effect: Drains moisture and vitality from one creature. Plant creatures and plant hazards have disadvantage on the save.
records.limited_use_rule: If assigned as limited, uses equal the hero’s current Game Level unless the power states another cost.

records.name: Blinding Smite

records.effect: The next weapon hit deals extra radiant damage; a failed save blinds the target, which repeats the save at the end of each turn.
records.limited_use_rule: If assigned as limited, uses equal the hero’s current Game Level unless the power states another cost.

records.name: Crushing Grip

records.limited_use_rule: If assigned as limited, uses equal the hero’s current Game Level unless the power states another cost.

records.name: Cure Wounds

records.investigation_utility: Can reveal warm bodies and movement without revealing private evidence.
records.limited_use_rule: If assigned as limited, uses equal the hero’s current Game Level unless the power states another cost.

records.name: Darkness
records.resolution: No save; blocked by qualifying magical light

records.investigation_utility: Conceals movement and evidence but may also reveal light-sensitive clues.
records.limited_use_rule: If assigned as limited, uses equal the hero’s current Game Level unless the power states another cost.

records.name: Death Ward
records.resolution: No roll
records.effect: The first time the target would drop to 0 HP before the duration ends, it drops to 1 HP instead; an instant-kill effect is negated once.
records.limited_use_rule: If assigned as limited, uses equal the hero’s current Game Level unless the power states another cost.

records.name: Deathfire Grasp
records.resolution: Constitution save; half damage on success

records.name: Detect Ailment

records.effect: Reveals poison, disease, curse, ongoing damage, and abnormal condition sources affecting visible creatures or evidence.
records.investigation_utility: Identifies poison traces, disease vectors, and whether a corpse or clue was altered by an ailment.
records.limited_use_rule: If assigned as limited, uses equal the hero’s current Game Level unless the power states another cost.

records.name: Dispel Magic
records.resolution: Automatic for low-tier effects; otherwise Charisma check against DC 10 + effect tier
records.effect: Ends one spell, magical trap, curse layer, or magical environmental effect that qualifies.
records.investigation_utility: Disables magical wards and reveals whether a clue was magically altered.
records.limited_use_rule: If assigned as limited, uses equal the hero’s current Game Level unless the power states another cost.

records.limited_use_rule: If assigned as limited, uses equal the hero’s current Game Level unless the power states another cost.

records.limited_use_rule: If assigned as limited, uses equal the hero’s current Game Level unless the power states another cost.

records.name: Scorched Soul

records.name: Self Teleport
records.resolution: No roll if destination is visible and unoccupied
records.effect: Teleport to a space you can see. This movement does not trigger opportunity attacks.
records.investigation_utility: Crosses pits, barred gaps, and some discovered secret routes.
records.limited_use_rule: If assigned as limited, uses equal the hero’s current Game Level unless the power states another cost.

records.name: Senseless

records.name: Sorcerer's Grasp

records.effect: A spectral hand pulls an unattended object up to 15 feet or pulls a failed creature 10 feet. It can operate visible switches, doors, evidence, or traps from range.

records.resolution: Triggered when a creature succeeds or fails a D20 Test by 2 or less

records.limited_use_rule: If assigned as limited, uses equal the hero’s current Game Level unless the power states another cost.

records.effect: Summons or raises one Undead Warrior under Gunnus’s control. Only one may be active unless a higher-level feature states otherwise.
records.duration: Until destroyed, dismissed, or the encounter ends

records.name: Underworld Flames

records.effect: Hellfire erupts and leaves burning ground until the start of the user’s next turn.
records.limited_use_rule: If assigned as limited, uses equal the hero’s current Game Level unless the power states another cost.

records.name: Vampiric Touch
records.resolution: Melee power attack

records.limited_use_rule: If assigned as limited, uses equal the hero’s current Game Level unless the power states another cost.

records.resolution: Strength save; half damage and no push on success
records.effect: A compressed-air strike pushes failed targets up to 20 feet and knocks them Prone if they collide with a solid surface.
records.limited_use_rule: If assigned as limited, uses equal the hero’s current Game Level unless the power states another cost.
